name: adjust_self
description: Change how you present yourself: your speaker volume, how fast you talk, your voice, how much you say, how strongly you follow faces, and whether you make a thinking sound. Call this whenever someone asks you to be louder, quieter, faster, slower, briefer, chattier, or to change your voice -- and also when you decide on your own that it would help, for example turning yourself down when someone says you are too loud for the room. Call it with a setting and no value to report what that setting is now, or with no setting at all to report all of them.

setting.description: Which part of yourself to adjust. Omit to report everything.

value.description: Either a relative word (up, down, louder, quieter, faster, slower, max, min, on, off) or an exact value (a number 0-100 for volume, 0.5-2.0 for speech_speed, a voice name such as bm_george). Omit to report the setting's current value without changing it.
